annotations.title: Turn an item into another format

description: Use this when the user wants one of their Xenition items turned into a different format: a task board, calendar events, a form or a slide deck — e.g. meeting notes into a board of action items, or a document into a deck. Creates a new item and returns it; the original is unchanged.

artifactId.description: the source artifact to repurpose (from search_artifacts / get_artifact)

target.description: what to turn it into: 'board' (tasks), 'calendar' (events), 'form', or 'slides' (a deck)

title.description: optional title for the new artifact; defaults to the source title

name: repurpose_artifact
title: Turn an item into another format
